source='''def transform(grid):
    """Recover the zeroed rectangle by reflecting across the main diagonal."""
    zero_cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    if not zero_cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in zero_cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in zero_cells) + 1
    c0 = min(c for r, c in zero_cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in zero_cells) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0, r1):
        for c in range(c0, c1):
            out[r][c] = grid[c][r]
    return out
'''
